source.title: TCA 1997 s.530
source.note: As-enacted 1997 text — no LRC revised TCA exists (docs/statutes/tca-1997/README.md). The definitions here (relevant contract, relevant operations) remain part of the current RCT scheme alongside ss.530A-530V (inserted by Finance Act 2011 s.20; the load-bearing rate-determination sections, 530A/530E/530G/530H/530I, are ingested separately below — see `ingestTca1997RctFa2011Section`). The pre-2012 compliance mechanics this section also defines (certificate of authorisation, relevant payments card) were superseded by the electronic system and are not curated into any rule here.
